title: Eru (soup)
lead:
{{Short description|Cameroon soup}}
{{no footnotes|date=July 2017}}
'''Eru''' is a vegetable  from [[Cameroon]]. It is a specialty of the [[Bayangi]] people, of the [[Manyu (department)|Manyu]] departement in [[Southwest Region (Cameroon)|southwestern Cameroon]]. It is vegetable soup made up of finely shredded leaves of the [[Gnetum africanum|eru or okok]]. The eru is cooked with [[Talinum fruticosum|waterleaf]] or spinach, [[palm oil]], crayfish, and either smoked fish, cow skin (kanda) or beef.

This dish is traditionally eaten with fermented [[fufu|water-fufu]] or [[garri]].
